inferential_unit: independently generated crystallographic occupancy realization paired with one independent velocity initialization
design_limit: The five primary temperature-series runs pair each occupancy with one velocity seed, so activation-energy heterogeneity is configuration-plus-velocity heterogeneity rather than pure occupancy variance. A separate balanced five-occupancy by three-velocity design identifies between-occupancy and within-occupancy variance at 800 K only.

hard_rules.unresolved_point_action: Block that estimator's hierarchical fit and extend the corresponding trajectory under a newly fingerprinted protocol; never drop the point or temperature.

arrhenius_model.configuration_fit: weighted least squares with conservative chi-square covariance scaling
arrhenius_model.population_fit: REML random-effects meta-analysis of paired configuration/velocity activation energies with modified Hartung-Knapp interval

prediction_targets.population_mean: uncertainty in the configuration-population geometric mean
prediction_targets.new_configuration: empirical configuration-plus-velocity predictive distribution with within-trajectory uncertainty

non_arrhenius_test.models: occupancy fixed intercepts plus common linear term versus the same model plus a common quadratic term in centered 1/(k_B*T)
non_arrhenius_test.claim_rule: Claim curvature only when both criteria pass; otherwise retain the linear Arrhenius primary model and report the diagnostic.

nested_velocity_inference.model: heteroskedastic REML random occupancy intercept plus within-occupancy velocity variance and known trajectory-measurement variance

measurement_variance.collective_to_tracer_ratio: variance of paired per-block log(D_collective/D_tracer) divided by the number of valid paired blocks

occupancy_variance_test.method: REML likelihood-ratio statistic with parametric-bootstrap null distribution at the zero-variance boundary

variance_interval_bootstrap.method: parametric bootstrap from the fitted full nested model

hard_rules.unresolved_action: Block that estimator's nested analysis and extend the exact trajectory under a separately fingerprinted protocol; never remove the cell.
hard_rules.claim_rule: An occupancy-level effect is supported only when the boundary-aware bootstrap p-value is no larger than alpha. Point estimates or range comparisons alone are descriptive.

block_bootstrap.resampling_rule: resample non-overlapping trajectory blocks independently within each physical run and form the comparison-minus-reference mean log effect

finite_size_equivalence.claim_rule: Finite-size convergence is supported for an estimator only when the full 95% block-bootstrap interval for D_188/D_94, or for the collective-to-tracer ratio contrast, lies inside [1/2,2].

volume_robustness.claim_rule: Fixed-experimental and NPT-volume effects are reported at every planned temperature. Robustness requires all estimator effect intervals inside [1/2,2] and the absolute NPT-minus-fixed activation-energy difference no larger than 0.05 eV; failure changes the claim rather than deleting the sensitivity.

hard_rules.missing_or_unresolved_action: Block only the affected estimator/comparison and extend the exact trajectory under a separately fingerprinted protocol.

velocity_design.analysis: nested random-effects variance decomposition with a boundary-aware parametric-bootstrap test for the occupancy variance

excluded_velocity_runs.reason: These original entries used 10 ps equilibration while the primary points use 20 ps; exact-structure matched replacements are frozen in llzto_velocity_nested_v2.json.

superseded_velocity_protocol.reason: It independently repeated numerical relaxation for each velocity cell. Version 2 instead reuses the exact byte-hashed relaxed structure from the corresponding primary run and is the only velocity protocol to execute.

excluded_finite_size_run.reason: The conventional CIF was independently re-ordered and therefore confounds cell size with a different Li/Ta occupancy realization. It is not run or used for a finite-size claim.

excluded_fixed_volume_run.reason: The original entry used 10 ps equilibration while the primary reference uses 20 ps. It is not run or used for a volume-effect claim.

preregistration_note: Frozen while the first formal trajectory was still incomplete and before any formal diffusivity or activation-energy result existed. The balanced 800 K velocity-within-occupancy amendment was added after a design audit, still before the first formal point completed.
